name: Admin payment account and instruction CRUD affect checkout
description: Verify admin CRUD for bank accounts and transfer instructions, validation, active visibility, and public checkout configuration.

planSteps.description: Log in as admin and open Pengaturan pembayaran.
Verify two active seed accounts and four active instructions are loaded from backend.
Create active bank account TestSprite Bank, number 5555516161, holder TESTSPRITE RAF STORE, order 99.
Verify the account is persisted and active count increases.
Open Instruksi transfer and create active instruction title TestSprite Payment Step, text Gunakan referensi TS-PAYMENT-20260716 saat melakukan transfer, order 99.
Verify the instruction is persisted and active instruction count increases.
Open a public checkout payment step with a cart item and valid shipping details.
Verify TestSprite Bank and TestSprite Payment Step are visible in live public payment settings.
Return as admin and delete TestSprite Bank and TestSprite Payment Step.
Verify both test records are removed and seed configuration remains.
